# `toolu gc`

Reclaim what finished epics, gates and sandboxes leave behind; a report unless --apply.

Owner: `plugins/toolu`.

## `toolu gc`

```text
Reclaim what finished epics, gates and sandboxes leave behind; a report unless --apply

Usage: toolu gc [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --apply             Remove merged worktrees, branches, snapshots and old job logs; stop idle VMs
      --json              Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
  -q, --quiet             Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --repo <PATH>       A checkout to sweep, besides this one and those the epic records name
      --host <HOST>       The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse, opencode]
      --config-dir <DIR>  Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
  -h, --help              Print help
```
